title: The Hook Low Enough
youtube_title: The Hook Low Enough | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Gratitude is a useful favor, not only a thank-you word.
summary: At a cottage kitchen on an ordinary kind morning, Yuri notices that Cousin Pio has already taken care of a hook moved lower so you could reach your own towel. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Yuri does one useful thing Cousin Pio did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
